question.en: Draw a class diagram for the system described by the following text: The system of the electronic devices vendor keeps information about the products - name, type of product, brand, code and price. The users can search these products, add them to their shopping carts and then make orders. For each user the system keeps track of their user number, name, address and phone number. When a user decides to buy the products in their shopping cart, an order is created. For each order we know the number of the order, a short description and the total sum, as well as the user that made the order and which products are ordered with corresponding quantities. The system also offers an option for the users to pay in installments. For each installment payment we know the user that made the payment and the order that the payment is for, as well as the date and the sum that was paid. At any moment we can see the history of orders or the history of payments for a user.

question.en: Draw a class diagram for the system described in the following text: The system for the sports center stores information about each hall, where every hall has a type, capacity, and location. Users have basic contact information, including first name, last name, email, and phone number. Each use of a hall is recorded through a reservation, which includes data about the user, the hall, the date, and the time of the reservation. Additionally, the system keeps track of payments. For each payment, it is known which user made the payment, which reservation it applies to, the amount paid, and the date of the payment. At any time, a user can view their reservation history as well as the history of their payments.
